window.note: Normal case, no STEP 1B exception. run_state.window_end was 2026-08-23 and is earlier than today, so window_start is the previous window_end and window_end is today: one day. Not padded to 14. summaries/2026-08-24.json did not exist and runs/2026-08-24.json was the lowest free slot, so this is not a same-day re-run. The clock at the time of the sweep was 2026-08-24 05:11 UTC / 00:11 CDT, which is why no US Monday release could be in scope.

route_note: raw.githubusercontent.com was unreachable again: the fetch tool refused https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andresen81-create/agri-climate-corpus/main/index/run_state.json with 'URL not in provenance set' before the request left the sandbox. That is a tool-side allowlist refusal, not an HTTP response from GitHub, so there is no status code and no x-deny-reason header to report. Identical to 2026-08-10, both runs of 2026-08-16, 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-23 — five consecutive runs. Fell back to the git route as STEP 1 instructs, cloned with the token and read all eight state files from the working copy. Both load-bearing files, claims_index.json and badge_map.json, read cleanly, so the run proceeded.
script_note: No script in the repo was run, including validate.py, per the STEP 8B prohibition. Index and shard consistency was checked directly: every corpus/<YYYY-MM>.json was rewritten by filtering all.json on the month field and then compared field-for-field against all.json.

sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.USDA NASS Crop Progress: Weekly, released Monday afternoon US Eastern time. The report for the week ending 23 August had not been released when this run swept: local time in the US Central zone was 00:11 on 24 August. The 17 August report is already in the corpus at u011-u018. This is the single largest item the window misses and the next run will pick it up.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.AHDB: The third GB Harvest Progress report of 2026 is still not published; the second, dated 14 August, is in the corpus at s001-s008. The Arable Market Report of 17 August predates window_start. Nothing carries a date of 23 or 24 August.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.Environment Agency: The 14-20 August drought report was published 21 August and is already in the corpus at v001-v005. The next weekly report is due about 28 August. Note for the next run: the 21 August report flags 680 Severn-catchment abstraction restrictions to be requested in the week commencing 24 August and 261 voluntary Wye restrictions; those were published outside this window, so no row was taken.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.WASDE / JRC MARS / GEOGLAM / USDA FAS WA: All monthly, all published 6-14 August or earlier, all before window_start and already captured. CONAB's next grain survey is due in September.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.Buenos Aires Grain Exchange: Nothing published 23-24 August was reachable. Argentina has now produced zero rows across five consecutive runs, which is worth a human look at whether the source is reachable at all from this sandbox.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.ABARES: Nothing since 2026-06-02, now 2.8 months. Quarterly, next due September, so the calendar explains it.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.ICCO / SA Crop Estimates Committee / GB: last_publication still null for all three. Nothing in window.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.Pro Farmer Crop Tour: The Tour closed on 21 August and its national and state numbers are in the corpus at v007-v014. One Tour figure remains uncaptured and is out of window: Minnesota corn at 199.01 bu/acre against 202.86 in 2025, published about 20-21 August. Flagged for a human rather than back-dated in.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.Company pass (pass 4): Zero rows. Lamb Weston's Q4 FY2026, Hershey's Q2 and Barry Callebaut's outlook cut all predate the window by weeks or months; McCain, ADM, Bunge, Cargill, Louis Dreyfus, ABF, Tate & Lyle and AGCO published nothing dated 23 or 24 August. This pass is quarterly by nature and zero rows outside earnings season is the expected result.
sources_checked_with_nothing_in_window.Brazil, southern Africa, SE Asia, palm o: Nothing carrying a publication date verifiably inside 23-24 August on a mapped host. The Barchart cocoa and West African weather pages state no publication date, exactly as the 23 August run found; no row taken rather than guess a date.
